{{Quote|If it has blood, you can make it bleed. If it has eyes, you can blind it. If it has a mouth, you can make it scream&hellip;|Inscription found on an ancient lanvarok|<ref name="NEGWT" />}}
The '''Massassi lanvarok''' was a primitive version of the [[lanvarok]]. [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] warriors used this primitive version more than the rest of [[Sith (species)/Legends|their species]]: a two-handed polearm that required brute strength rather than mechanical action or [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to launch the same discs fired by a [[Sith lanvarok]]. After its disks were launched, the polearm itself could be used as a battle axe.

==Description==
An exotic weapon when not in the hands of those for whom it was specialized, the Massassi lanvarok was one of two lanvarok variants: the [[Sith lanvarok]], and the Massassi counterpart.<ref name="KOTORCG" /> Details on the construction and design of Massassi lanvaroks could be found in [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Holocron/Legends|holocrons]]. Unlike the Sith lanvarok, however, the Massassi variant was considered to be more primitive.<ref name="DSS" />

==History==
Like the Sith lanvarok, the Massassi lanvarok was an ancient weapon, designed in early Sith history for the left-handed tendencies of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith people]]. As the name suggests, the Massassi lanvarok was unique to the Massassi Sith [[Species/Legends|subspecies]].<ref name="KOTORCG" /> According to ancient Sith legend, the lanvarok was originally designed with the intention of being used as a hunting weapon.<ref name="DSS" />
